verdict.rationale: Abacum is a SaaS FP&A platform. Whether its source is available under an open license is a fair question for a product of this kind, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a public repository, source availability or an open-source license; it covers only proprietary platform features, integrations and security controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
